title: toxicodendron radicans subsp. negundo
intro: Toxicodendron radicans subsp. negundo, commonly known as the variegated poison ivy or nettle leaf poison ivy, is a plant species that belongs to the Anacardiaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Toxicodendron radicans subsp. negundo include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory actions, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds.
